matches.note: Sîn šar ilāni rēšiya ullīma šuma ṭāba ina māti iškunanni 'Sîn, king of the gods, lifted up my head and set a good name for me in the land' ~ wa-rafaʿnā laka dhikrak 'and we raised your name (mention) for you' (94:4).
